NousResearch/hermes-agent.summary: Hermes Agent is a self-improving AI agent designed to provide persistent memory and autonomous skill development across multiple sessions. It utilizes a closed learning loop to create and refine skills from experience while employing FTS5 session search for cross-session recall. The agent supports various LLM providers and can be deployed across diverse environments including local machines, VPS, or serverless infrastructure. It features a multi-platform gateway for continuous interaction via Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, and Signal.
highlights: Autonomous skill creation and self-improvement through experience
Cross-platform continuity via Telegram, Discord, and Slack integrations
Flexible deployment on local, Docker, SSH, or serverless backends

NousResearch/Hermes-Function-Calling.summary: Hermes-Function-Calling provides a framework for the Hermes Pro Large Language Model to execute specific tasks through structured tool use. It utilizes a recursive loop to generate function calls, execute them via Python scripts, and process the returned data. The repository supports both standard function calling and JSON mode inference using Pydantic models for schema validation. Users can extend the system by integrating custom functions and tools, such as financial data retrieval via the yfinance library.
highlights: Supports function calling and JSON mode inference
Allows custom tool integration via Python scripts
Uses Pydantic for structured JSON schema validation

NousResearch/atropos.summary: Atropos is an environment microservice framework designed to facilitate asynchronous reinforcement learning for large language models. It utilizes a service-based architecture for environments paired with a trajectory API to manage data flow between environments and trainers. The framework supports diverse tasks including tool calling, code execution, and multimodal interactions. It is intended to provide a scalable platform for accelerating LLM research across interactive settings.
highlights: Supports async RL via environment microservices
Handles diverse tasks from code to multimodal
Provides a trajectory API for trainer integration

NousResearch/hermes-agent-self-evolution.summary: Hermes Agent Self-Evolution is a framework for the automatic improvement of Hermes Agent's capabilities. It utilizes DSPy and Genetic-Pareto Prompt Evolution (GEPA) to optimize skills, prompts, and code through reflective evolutionary search. The system analyzes execution traces to propose targeted mutations without requiring GPU training. All evolved variants are subject to strict guardrails, including test suites and size limits, before undergoing human review via pull requests.
highlights: Optimizes skills and prompts using DSPy and GEPA
No GPU training required; operates via API calls
Strict guardrails including full test suites and size limits

NousResearch/hermes-paperclip-adapter.summary: The hermes-paperclip-adapter is a bridge that integrates Hermes Agent into the Paperclip company management system as a managed employee. It functions by wrapping the Hermes CLI, parsing raw terminal output into structured transcript entries and clean markdown for the Paperclip UI. This allows the agent to respond to task assignments and issue comments while utilizing its native suite of 30+ tools and persistent memory. The adapter also manages session state, skill synchronization, and multi-provider inference settings directly within the Paperclip environment.
highlights: Integrates Hermes Agent as a managed employee in Paperclip systems
Parses raw CLI output into structured tool cards and markdown
Supports 8 inference providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter

NousResearch/autonovel.summary: Autonovel is an autonomous pipeline designed to generate complete, print-ready novels from a seed concept. It employs a modify-evaluate-keep/discard loop across four phases, moving from world-building and drafting to automated revision and final export. The system integrates a dual-persona review process using Claude Opus to refine prose and structure. The pipeline can produce a variety of final formats, including PDFs, ePubs, audiobooks, and landing pages.
highlights: Multi-phase pipeline from seed concept to print-ready PDF/ePub
Dual-persona review loop using Claude Opus for literary critique
Integrated art generation and ElevenLabs multi-voice audiobook production

outsourc-e/hermes-workspace.summary: Hermes Workspace is a comprehensive command center designed to orchestrate AI agents through a unified web interface. It integrates with the vanilla hermes-agent to provide a zero-fork environment for managing chat, memory, and system operations. The platform features a Swarm Mode that utilizes tmux-backed workers for autonomous, role-based task dispatching and a Kanban board for tracking progress. Users can manage over 2,000 skills, browse MCP catalogs, and access a cross-platform PTY terminal from a single dashboard.
highlights: Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers
Integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog
Full workspace file browser with Monaco and PTY terminal

fathah/hermes-desktop.summary: Hermes Desktop is a native companion application that provides a graphical interface for installing, configuring, and interacting with the Hermes Agent AI assistant. It replaces manual CLI management by automating the installation process via the official script and storing configurations in a dedicated local directory. The app enables users to manage complex agent features like tool use, memory, and multi-platform messaging gateways through a unified dashboard. It supports a wide range of local and remote backends, including OpenAI-compatible endpoints and various cloud providers.
highlights: Guided installation and dependency resolution for Hermes Agent
Unified GUI for chat, session history, and profile management
Support for 14 toolsets including web browsing and code execution

sanchomuzax/hermes-webui.summary: Hermes WebUI is a dedicated monitoring and configuration dashboard for the Hermes Agent ecosystem. It functions as a non-intrusive polling bridge that reads from the agent's SQLite database and YAML files to provide real-time visibility without requiring modifications to the core agent code. Users can track session histories, monitor gateway health, and inspect skill source code through a responsive React-based interface. The tool also facilitates the management of scheduled cron jobs and provides read-only access to environment configurations.
highlights: Real-time activity tracking with WebSocket-based status updates
Full-text search for browsing and inspecting conversation histories
Visual management for scheduled cron jobs and agent skills

Euraika-Labs/pan-ui.summary: Pan is a self-hosted web dashboard and workspace designed specifically for the Hermes Agent runtime. It provides a centralized interface to manage agent interactions through a chat-first environment that supports SSE streaming and tool timelines. Users can discover and install skills from skills.sh, manage MCP integrations, and organize work into isolated profiles with unique memory and sessions. The system includes a setup wizard that automatically detects Hermes configurations and can run as a background daemon or system service.
highlights: Chat-first workspace with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards
Integrated marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers
Isolated profile management for separate sessions, memory, and API keys

mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills.summary: Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills is an open-source library designed to provide AI agents with the specialized knowledge of a senior security analyst. It contains 817 structured skills across 29 security domains, following the agentskills.io open standard. Each skill is mapped across six industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and the MITRE Fight Fraud Framework (F3), to ensure unified cross-framework coverage. This allows agents to perform expert-level security investigations and maintain compliance across multiple standards.
highlights: 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains
Unified mapping to six major cybersecurity and AI frameworks
Compatible with 26+ AI platforms and Hermes Agent

conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing.summary: avoid-ai-writing is a portable skill designed to audit and rewrite content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It utilizes a structured approach involving a 109-entry word replacement table and 50 pattern categories to identify and fix 'AI-isms.' The tool is compatible with various agent ecosystems including Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw, offering specialized modes for detection, rewriting, or in-place editing.
highlights: Supports rewrite, detect, and in-place edit modes
Uses a multi-tier word replacement and pattern detection system
Compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw agents

wondelai/skills.summary: Wondel.ai Skills is a cross-platform library of specialized skill sets designed to enhance the capabilities of AI agents. It provides structured knowledge modules based on established frameworks<pad> such as UX design, product strategy, and software architecture. Users can install these skills via Claude Code, skills.sh, or OpenAI Codex to<pad> integrate domain-specific expertise into their agentic workflows.
highlights: Supports Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents
Organized into specialized collections like UX design and<pad> sales influence
Installable via CLI using npx skills or Claude plugin marketplace

DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills.summary: pydantic-ai-skills is a standardized framework for managing modular agent capabilities within the Pydantic AI ecosystem. It implements the Agent Skills open specification by providing a tool-calling mechanism that allows agents to discover and execute specialized scripts or instructions. The library uses a progressive disclosure approach, loading skill details only when relevant to minimize token consumption. Developers can define these skills through local filesystem directories or programmatically using Python decorators and dataclasses.
highlights: Implements the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI
Reduces token usage through progressive disclosure of skill metadata
Supports both filesystem-based and programmatic Python skill definitions

Agents365-ai/drawio-skill.summary: drawio-skill is a tool that converts natural language descriptions into editable .drawio XML diagrams. It utilizes the native draw.io desktop CLI to export these diagrams into PNG, SVG, PDF, or JPG formats. The skill can automatically visualize codebases, SQL schemas, and Infrastructure-as-Code files into structured diagrams. It is compatible with various agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and Hermes via the Agent Skills format.
highlights: Converts Mermaid text and SQL DDL into native .drawio files
Visualizes codebases in Python, JS-TS, Go, and Rust
Includes 321 AI/LLM brand logos and 10,000+ official shapes

smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills.summary: This repository provides a collection of official coding skills for Chainlink, enabling AI agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts. The project implements the agentskills.io specification to allow agents to discover and activate specific capabilities based on the task. It supports a variety of Chainlink services including CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and ACE. These skills help developers automate the creation of development plans and the implementation of cross-chain tokenized projects.
highlights: Compliant with the agentskills.io specification
Supports CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams
Installable via the Vercel CLI for open skills ecosystem

tlehman/litprog-skill.summary: The litprog-skill is a Claude Code extension that implements Donald Knuth's literate programming paradigm by transforming codebases into human-readable narratives. It works by generating a .lit.md file that weaves together prose, Mermaid diagrams, and LaTeX math with the original source code. The tool includes a tangler to extract runnable files and a reverse-sync engine to ensure the documentation stays updated when source files are edited. This approach helps developers document architectural decisions and facilitates easier onboarding through structured, essay-like code explanations.
highlights: Generates .lit.md files combining prose, diagrams, and source code
Extracts runnable source files from documentation using a tangler
Automatically syncs source file edits back to the literate document

esaradev/icarus-plugin.summary: Icarus is a Hermes plugin that provides agents with shared memory and a pipeline for creating replacement models. It captures agent decisions and work into a markdown-based directory, allowing different agent profiles to access a common knowledge base. This captured data is then filtered by quality and exported as training pairs for fine-tuning cheaper models via Together AI. Users can evaluate these candidate models and switch to them once they meet specific performance thresholds.
highlights: Cross-instance shared memory via markdown files
Automated capture of high-value decisions and outcomes
Pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models

chigwell/skilldock.io.summary: SkillDock.io is a registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It provides an OpenAPI-driven Python SDK and CLI to manage, search, and install versioned skills. Users can automate skill discovery, handle commerce via TON, and manage local skill installations with dependency resolution. The platform supports immutable release versioning and detailed metadata management through SKILL.md files.
highlights: OpenAPI-driven Python SDK and CLI
Versioned skill management and installation
Commerce support via TON payments

black-forest-labs/skills.summary: This project provides official image generation skills for FLUX models, offering standardized prompting guidelines and API integration patterns following the agentskills.io specification. It functions as a technical resource for developers to implement text-to-image and image-to-image workflows through structured JSON prompting, hex color specification, and multi-reference editing. The repository includes a model selection guide for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 variants and can be integrated directly into Claude Code as a plugin. Users can access documented API patterns for asynchronous polling, webhook verification, and rate limit management.
highlights: Standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families
API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling
Support for JSON structured prompting and precise hex color specification

Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory.summary: Skill Factory is a meta-skill for Hermes Agent that automates the creation of reusable skills by monitoring user workflows. It functions by tracking session patterns in the background and proposing structured skill definitions when it detects repeatable sequences. Users can generate both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds directly from these proposals via slash commands or natural language. This tool streamlines the expansion of the Hermes ecosystem by turning manual environment setups and development tasks into permanent, executable assets.
highlights: Automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows
Generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds
Provides slash commands to manage, list, and save detected patterns

ReinaMacCredy/maestro.summary: maestro is a local-first Rust harness designed to provide coding agents with a durable, file-backed workspace for long-running tasks. It operates by storing work items, decisions, and progress as plain files or SQLite records within a repository's .maestro/ directory, eliminating the need for background daemons or cloud services. This approach ensures that agent reasoning, task dependencies, and QA evidence remain queryable and reviewable through standard git diffs even across multiple sessions. The system uses a hierarchical card model to manage product contracts, executable tasks, and harness improvements, allowing humans to steer while agents execute and document their own lifecycle.
highlights: Local-first architecture using plain files and SQLite for durable agent memory.
Three-level work model comprising cards, workflow kinds, and atomic tasks.
Evidence-based lifecycle gating through mandatory proof and QA sidecar facets.

tiann/execplan-skill.summary: ExecPlan is an Agent Skill designed to help AI coding agents autonomously manage complex, long-running implementation tasks. It utilizes a structured execution plan that allows users to review and approve the approach before implementation starts. The system tracks progress in real-time and provides rollback procedures for safe recovery. It is compatible with tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Goose.
highlights: Autonomous execution for long-running tasks
Real-time tracking of progress and decisions
Built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery

cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill.summary: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive client designed to optimize token usage when interacting with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It implements a three-layer lazy loading architecture that allows AI agents to discover server metadata, list available tools, and fetch specific schemas only when necessary. By utilizing a socket-based daemon to maintain persistent connections, it avoids the overhead of loading entire toolsets into the AI's context at once. This approach significantly reduces token consumption while providing a standardized way to manage multiple MCP servers through a single interface.
highlights: Three-layer progressive disclosure reduces token usage by up to 86%
Socket-based daemon maintains persistent connections to multiple MCP servers
Supports hot-reloading server configurations without restarting the daemon

armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge.summary: Skill Forge is a tool that converts code repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into verified instruction files to prevent AI agents from hallucinating API calls. It extracts function signatures and types, linking every instruction back to a specific file and line number at a pinned commit or a documentation URL. This approach provides a version-pinned audit trail via a provenance map, ensuring instructions remain accurate as libraries evolve. It is designed for developers maintaining libraries or managing complex dependencies who need reproducible, falsifiable agent skills.
highlights: Traces instructions to specific file lines and pinned commits
Generates agentskills.io-compliant skills from code or documentation
Supports version-pinned storage to prevent instruction rot

amanning3390/hermeshub.summary: HermesHub is an ARD-compliant agent registry that enables the discovery and indexing of AI agent capabilities. It utilizes a Hermes Agent to autonomously crawl, validate, and index manifests hosted at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json endpoints. Users can list agents for free via self-publishing or through a paid hosted listing that includes health checks. The platform supports ranked discovery via a standardized search API and maintains federation with Hugging Face Discover and GitHub Agent Finder.
highlights: Full implementation of Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification
Autonomous 24/7 operation via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure
Federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face

PederHP/skillsdotnet.summary: SkillsDotNet is a C#/.NET implementation of the agentskills.io standard designed to integrate agent skills into the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It uses a skill:// URI convention to implement progressive disclosure, allowing clients to discover lightweight skill metadata before loading full documentation or supporting files. The library provides seamless integration with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and supports automatic discovery of skills from various agent directories like Claude, Cursor, and Copilot.
highlights: Implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files
Integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading
Supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories

mem0ai/mem0.summary: Mem0 is an intelligent memory layer that provides AI agents with the ability to remember user preferences and adapt over time. It utilizes a multi-signal retrieval system combining semantic, BM25 keyword, and entity matching with temporal reasoning to rank dated instances. The system supports multi-level state retention across users, sessions, and agents through a flexible deployment model. It is available as a Python/npm library, a self-hosted server, or a managed cloud service.
highlights: Multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent state
Hybrid retrieval using semantic, keyword, and entity matching
Time-aware retrieval for current state and past events

vectorize-io/hindsight.summary: Hindsight is an agent memory system designed to help AI agents learn and evolve over time rather than just recalling conversation history. It utilizes a long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflow to manage information and build mental models that outperform standard RAG and knowledge graph techniques. The system can be integrated via a two-line LLM wrapper or a direct API to automate memory storage and retrieval. It is particularly suited for autonomous AI employees that must adapt behavior based on user feedback and handle complex, open-ended tasks.
highlights: Implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent learning
Provides an LLM wrapper for two-line integration with existing agents
Supports per-user memory isolation using custom metadata and filtering

greyhaven-ai/autocontext.summary: autocontext is a recursive self-improvement harness that enables AI agents to refine their performance on complex tasks through iterative evaluation. The system executes tasks against specific scenarios, retains successful strategies in playbooks, and discards ineffective approaches to build a persistent knowledge base. It generates structured artifacts including traces, reports, and datasets that can be used to distill agent behavior into local-model training data. The toolkit supports multiple integration paths including MCP servers, a CLI-first skill for Hermes, and a dedicated Pi extension.
highlights: Generates persistent playbooks and hints from iterative task runs
Exports CLI-first skills specifically formatted for Hermes agent integration
Distills successful agent behaviors into local-model training artifacts

elkimek/honcho-self-hosted.summary: This project provides a configuration layer for self-hosting Plastic Labs' Honcho memory backend, enabling cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent without relying on third-party cloud storage. It deploys the full Honcho stack—including the API, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and Redis—on local hardware using Docker Compose. Users can route memory extraction and reasoning tasks through any OpenAI-compatible API or local inference servers like Ollama to maintain data sovereignty. This setup allows Hermes to build long-term user profiles and logical observations while keeping conversation data on the user's own infrastructure.
highlights: Enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent via self-hosting
Supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers
Includes automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis

yoloshii/ClawMem.summary: ClawMem is a local-first memory and context engine designed to provide persistent, on-device storage for AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes. It utilizes a hybrid retrieval architecture that combines vector search, BM25, and multi-graph traversal to surface relevant context from markdown notes and session transcripts. The system automatically captures decisions, manages document lifecycles with recency decay, and detects contradictions to maintain a coherent knowledge base. By operating entirely on-device via SQLite and Bun, it ensures data privacy and cross-runtime memory sharing without cloud dependencies.
highlights: Hybrid retrieval using vector search, BM25, and causal graph traversal.
Local-first architecture with no API keys or cloud dependencies.
Cross-runtime memory sharing for Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes agents.

plur-ai/plur.summary: PLUR is a local-first shared memory layer that allows AI agents to persist preferences, corrections, and conventions across different sessions and tools. It stores knowledge as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, utilizing a hybrid retrieval system with optional rerankers to inject relevant context into LLM calls. This approach enables smaller models to outperform larger ones on specific tasks by prioritizing context over model size, with integrations for Claude Code, Cursor, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw.
highlights: Open YAML engram format for readable, editable agent memory
Local-first, data-sovereign storage with zero-cost search
Cross-tool compatibility via MCP and dedicated Python/JS SDKs

amanning3390/flowstate-qmd.summary: FlowState-QMD is a local-first memory layer designed to provide coding agents with immediate project context from markdown documentation. It utilizes a SQLite-based vector store and an anticipatory cache that prefetches relevant documents by monitoring active agent session logs. This approach allows agents to access design docs, ADRs, and changelogs before initiating a reactive search loop. The system integrates via an MCP server and supports local execution using GGUF models and node-llama-cpp.
highlights: Anticipatory cache prefetches context by watching agent session logs
Local-first storage using SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp
MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients

robbyczgw-cla/hermes-web-search-plus.summary: Web Search Plus is a Hermes plugin that provides a multi-provider web search and extraction layer to prevent reliance on a single API. It uses a capability-based routing system to automatically select from 14 search and 8 extraction providers based on user configuration. The tool manages large page content by providing compact previews and handles provider failures through conservative fallback paths. It also includes built-in benchmarking to help users optimize provider selection based on latency and success rates.
highlights: Auto-routing across 14 search and 8 extraction providers
Smart handling of large pages via head/tail previews
Built-in provider benchmarking for quality diagnostics

42-evey/hermes-plugins.summary: Evey's Hermes Plugins is a collection of 23 custom extensions designed to enhance the autonomy, observability, and cost-efficiency of the Hermes Agent framework. The suite implements specialized logic for multi-model decision debates, smart task routing with fallback chains, and structured telemetry logging. These tools enable agents to manage their own goals, perform self-correction loops, and consolidate long-term memory into vector storage. Additionally, the project includes a bidirectional bridge for Claude Code and budget enforcement via Langfuse integration.
highlights: Autonomous planning, reflection, and multi-model consensus debate tools
Smart model routing with sensitivity filters and four-model fallback chains
Automated memory consolidation into Qdrant vectors and identity evolution

FahrenheitResearch/hermes-weather-plugin.summary: The Hermes Weather Plugin provides a suite of 13 meteorological tools for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, enabling real-time access to observations, forecasts, and high-fidelity model imagery. It utilizes a Python-first architecture that offloads heavy computational tasks, such as NEXRAD radar rendering and ECAPE calculations, to high-performance Rust backends. The plugin features an automated bootstrap process that compiles necessary Rust binaries on first use, ensuring a streamlined setup for complex weather analysis. Users can retrieve verified model soundings, severe weather outlooks from the SPC, and global data via Open-Meteo integration.
highlights: Thirteen tools for NWS forecasts, radar imagery, and severe weather alerts
Rust-backed meteorological calculations for ECAPE, soundings, and parcel profiles
Automated bootstrap system for compiling and caching required Rust binaries

42-evey/evey-bridge-plugin.summary: The Evey Bridge Plugin is a technical integration that connects Claude Code with the Evey hermes-agent stack. It functions by automatically checking for messages or tasks from the bridge and injecting them as context into every prompt submission. The plugin includes specialized commands for running a 'Mother Mode' improvement loop and monitoring system health, including wallet and cron status. It is designed specifically for users running the Evey stack at a designated local directory.
highlights: Injects Evey messages and tasks into Claude Code prompts
Automates Mother Mode improvement loops via the /evey-loop command
Monitors health, wallets, and crons with quick status checks

nativ3ai/hermes-payguard.summary: Hermes PayGuard is a security-focused plugin that enables Hermes Agents to handle USDC and x402 payments through a gated execution model. It separates payment preparation from execution by requiring an out-of-band human approval stamp for transfers exceeding user-defined policy limits. The system supports Circle developer-controlled wallets, cross-chain CCTP transfers, and automated x402 micropayments for paid HTTP fetches. This architecture ensures that while agents can stage financial intents, they cannot unilaterally move significant funds without explicit operator consent.
highlights: Enforces human-in-the-loop approval for high-value USDC transfers
Supports Circle CCTP for cross-chain USDC routing and execution
Automates x402 micropayments below configurable policy thresholds

raulvidis/hermes-cloudflare.summary: This plugin integrates Cloudflare's Browser Rendering API into the Hermes Agent ecosystem to enable web crawling and content extraction from JavaScript-heavy websites. It utilizes Cloudflare's headless browser infrastructure to perform tasks like CSS-selector scraping, PDF generation, and full-page screenshot capture. The tool also features AI-powered structured data extraction using Llama 3.3 70B via Workers AI. Users can automate complex web workflows including sitemap discovery and Markdown conversion directly through agent commands.
highlights: Crawls websites with depth controls and sitemap discovery support
Extracts structured JSON data using Workers AI and Llama 3.3
Converts fully rendered JavaScript-heavy pages into clean Markdown

builderz-labs/mission-control.summary: Mission Control is a self-hosted dashboard designed to manage and coordinate fleets of AI agents. It provides a centralized interface for dispatching tasks, tracking costs, and managing multi-agent workflows using a local-first architecture powered by SQLite. The platform features a real-time telemetry system for monitoring agent performance and includes built-in quality gates for human-in-the-loop task approval. It integrates with various frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph while offering specialized bridges for CLI tools like Claude Code.
highlights: Self-hosted orchestration dashboard with zero external dependencies using SQLite.
Multi-framework support for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and Claude SDK.
Integrated security auditing with secret detection and trust scoring.

swarmclawai/swarmclaw.summary: SwarmClaw is a self-hosted AI agent runtime and multi-agent framework designed to orchestrate autonomous swarms. It utilizes a centralized dashboard to manage agent memory, runtime skills, and delegation across more than 23 LLM providers including Hermes, Ollama, and Anthropic. The platform supports durable conversation history, scheduled tasks, and a learning system that converts reviewed conversations into reusable skills. Users can deploy the system via a desktop application, Docker, or a global NPM package to create structured agent hierarchies.
highlights: Supports 23+ LLM providers including Hermes, OpenAI, and Ollama
Features durable agent memory and conversation-to-skill learning
Orchestrates multi-agent swarms with delegation and scheduled heartbeats

howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness.summary: Hermes Agent Meta-Harness is a standalone outer-loop optimization framework designed to improve the performance of Hermes agents on verifiable coding benchmarks. It treats the agent as an execution backend and searches for optimal harness configurations—the code governing context collection and retrieval—rather than modifying model weights. The system orchestrates benchmark evaluations, tracks performance frontiers, and performs structured candidate mutations to find superior harness variants. It currently supports TBLite and TB2 benchmarks through a research-safe workflow that emphasizes archive analysis and deterministic search.
highlights: Optimizes agent harness code through automated outer-loop search
Orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations via Hermes
Tracks performance frontiers with structured candidate mutation and comparison

runtimenoteslabs/gladiator.summary: Gladiator is an autonomous agent arena that pits two AI companies against each other to compete for GitHub stars on identical repositories. The system uses Paperclip for orchestration and Hermes Agent workers to execute tasks according to distinct corporate strategies: growth-focused Blitz versus quality-focused Craft. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition through scoreboards, task boards, and audit trails. Upon completion, the project demonstrates cross-company skill transfer by merging the rival entities and their learned memories.
highlights: Orchestrates 9 autonomous agents across two competing AI companies
Uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning
Real-time dashboard visualizes agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics

1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent.summary: This project is a multi-agent orchestration system for OpenCode AI that automates complex software development workflows. It utilizes a master orchestrator to route requests through specialized pipelines consisting of 17 distinct agents for research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. The system enforces mandatory quality gates and security audits to ensure code consistency and safety. It supports various workflows including feature development, bug fixing, and performance optimization through structured context passing and revision loops.
highlights: 17 specialized agents for end-to-end software development
Strict pipeline architecture with mandatory quality and security gates
Integrated MCP server support for external documentation and web fetching

Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill.summary: The hermes-acp-orchestrator is a skill designed to standardize multi-agent delegation within engineering workflows. It functions by routing specific goals to specialized agents including Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code while maintaining strict context isolation. The system ensures operational stability through configurable safety controls such as execution timeouts and output character limits. This tool is primarily intended for complex tasks requiring distinct phases like implementation, risk analysis, and final synthesis.
highlights: Routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code.
Prevents parent context pollution through isolated delegation workflows.
Enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.

numtide/llm-agents.nix.summary: llm-agents.nix is a collection of Nix packages designed to simplify the installation and management of AI-powered coding agents and development tools. The project provides a centralized repository of Nix expressions that automate the deployment of various CLI and desktop-based agents, ensuring they are updated daily. By leveraging the Nix package manager, users can run a wide range of tools—including Claude Code, Google Antigravity, and GitHub Copilot CLI—directly from their terminal without manual configuration. This approach provides a reproducible environment for developers to experiment with different agentic coding platforms across various licenses and source types.
highlights: Provides Nix packages for numerous AI coding agents and CLI tools
Automates package updates on a daily basis for latest versions
Enables direct execution of agents via nix run commands

TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw.summary: HermesClaw is a deployment framework that runs the Hermes Agent within a hardware-enforced sandbox using NVIDIA OpenShell. It secures agent operations by intercepting system calls at the kernel level to block unauthorized network egress, filesystem writes, and dangerous process executions. The system includes a library of over 40 built-in tools and skills, such as web search and messaging gateways, which are governed by three distinct security policy presets. This setup allows developers to deploy autonomous agents for tasks like code review and research while ensuring the host system remains protected from rogue behavior.
highlights: Hardware-level enforcement of network, filesystem, and process boundaries
Three security presets ranging from strict inference to permissive access
Integrates with Telegram, Discord, and VS Code via ACP

0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent.summary: nix-hermes-agent provides a Nix package and NixOS module for the declarative deployment of Hermes Agent. It integrates natively with various platforms through the Model Context Protocol and a Python SDK, enabling consistent memory across tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenWebUI.
highlights: SQLite-backed storage with zero external cloud dependencies
Supports Model Context Protocol for integration with major agent frameworks
Features episodic compression and temporal knowledge graph capabilities

keepnotes-ai/keep.summary: Keep is a reflective memory system for AI agents that facilitates long-term learning and contextual awareness. It processes diverse inputs—including URLs, codebases, and multimedia—by summarizing, embedding, and organizing them into a searchable graph. The system uses 'edge tags' to create navigable relationships between notes, such as linking speakers to transcripts or commits to files. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other MCP-compatible tools to help agents track intentions and reflect on past actions.
highlights: Semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal
Automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support
Edge tags create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes

AMAP-ML/SkillClaw.summary: SkillClaw is a skill registry and evolution framework designed to prevent fragmented and redundant AI agent skill libraries. It uses an agentic evolver to automatically digest, deduplicate, and improve skills derived from real-world agent interactions. The system unifies skill libraries across multiple agents and devices, allowing experiences to compound through collective evolution. It features native integration with Hermes, OpenClaw, and various OpenAI-compatible APIs.
highlights: Automated skill deduplication and quality improvement
Unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices
Collective skill evolution for shared user teams

aivrar/portable-hermes-agent.summary: Portable Hermes Agent is a Windows-based desktop distribution of the Hermes Agent designed for users who cannot install software or lack administrator rights. It utilizes a portable Python environment and a Tkinter GUI to provide a zero-install experience without requiring Docker. The system integrates local model support via LM Studio and includes a workflow engine for automating multi-step pipelines. Users can further extend the agent using a built-in tool maker to create custom API wrappers or Python handlers.
highlights: No-install Windows desktop with GUI and admin-free setup
100 tools including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI extensions
Workflow engine for scheduled, multi-step automation pipelines

Cranot/super-hermes.summary: Super Hermes is a skill registry that enables Hermes Agent to dynamically generate its own analytical thinking instructions, known as prisms, to perform deep structural analysis. It shifts the agent from surface-level checklists to deriving structural trade-offs and identifying inherent impossibilities within a codebase or document. The system includes a transparency mechanism that explicitly reports analysis blind spots and constraints to the user.
highlights: Dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses via /prism-scan
Seven pre-built, validated prisms for resilience, optimization, and simulation
Constraint reporting to identify analysis blind spots via /prism-reflect

EfficientContext/ContextPilot.summary: ContextPilot is a context optimization engine designed to accelerate long-context LLM inference by maximizing prefix reuse. It functions by maintaining a context index that reorders shared blocks into common prefixes and removes duplicate content before sending optimized prompts to the inference server. This approach reduces KV cache recomputation and token usage across RAG, memory-heavy chat, and agentic workflows. The project provides native integrations for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, vLLM, and SGLang, supporting both local deployments and cloud APIs.
highlights: Optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse.
Reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% tokens.
Native plugin support for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.

335234131/agent-browser-mcp.summary: Agent-browser-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to interact directly with a user's active Chrome browser session rather than a sandboxed environment. It works through a local bridge and a Chrome extension to maintain existing login states, cookies, and open tabs while providing low-level control. The project allows agents to perform page scanning, execute JavaScript, and issue Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) commands. It also supports physical hardware interaction, including real mouse movements, keyboard inputs, and desktop screenshots.
highlights: Operates real Chrome sessions with preserved login states and cookies
Executes native CDP commands for advanced DOM and browser control
Supports physical mouse and keyboard inputs for human-like automation

jwangkun/hermes-agent-guide.summary: This project is a comprehensive Chinese-language guide designed to provide a systematic learning path for the Hermes Agent framework. It organizes fragmented documentation into 16 volumes covering the system's five-layer architecture, memory systems, and skill ecosystems. The guide includes practical tutorials for installation, MCP protocol integration, and multi-agent orchestration. highlights: Detailed analysis of five-layer architecture and three-layer memory system
Guides for 47 built-in tools and 6,000+ MCP service integrations
Deployment tutorials for local, Docker, and VPS environments

longyunfeigu/learn-hermes-agent.summary: Learn Hermes Agent is a code-first tutorial designed to teach the construction of production-grade autonomous AI agents using Python. It employs a 27-chapter structured path that guides users from building a basic conversation loop to implementing complex self-evolution mechanisms. The curriculum covers critical infrastructure including session persistence via SQLite, a multi-platform gateway for various messaging apps, and tool registry systems. It focuses on the architectural backbone required for agents to operate autonomously across different environments and persist knowledge over time.
highlights: Multi-platform gateway for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WeChat
Session persistence using SQLite with FTS5 for conversation memory
Advanced capabilities including MCP integration and RL-based self-evolution

jpalmae/hermeshq.summary: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate and manage multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It functions as an operational layer that wraps the Hermes execution engine, providing centralized task dispatching, scheduling, and a runtime ledger. The platform enables multi-agent delegation, RBAC-controlled user access, and per-agent communication channels for Telegram and WhatsApp. It also features an enterprise MCP bridge to expose specific agents to external AI clients like Claude Code and Codex.
highlights: Orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities
Provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and task scheduling
Offers enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations

plastic-labs/honcho.summary: Honcho is a memory infrastructure designed to provide stateful agents with a persistent understanding of people, groups, and ideas over time. It works by storing messages and events in sessions and using background reasoning to extract conclusions and update peer representations. Users can query these representations for natural-language insights or prompt-ready context via Python and TypeScript SDKs. The system supports both a managed cloud service and self-hosting via a FastAPI server, with integrations for MCP, Claude Code, and Hermes.
highlights: Reasoning-first memory that extracts conclusions from conversations
Peer-centric modeling of users, agents, and projects
Hybrid search combining BM25 and vector retrieval

adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud.summary: This project is a Hermes Agent skill that enables direct interaction with self-hosted Nextcloud instances for personal data management. It interfaces with Nextcloud using WebDAV, CalDAV, CardDAV, and the Notes API to perform operations without requiring a browser or third-party sync services. Users can manage files, edit notes, schedule calendar events, track tasks, and search contacts through a command-line interface. highlights: Manages files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via standard protocols.
Communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
Includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.

Xquik-dev/hermes-tweet.summary: Hermes Tweet is a native plugin that enables Hermes Agent to automate X (Twitter) tasks via the Xquik API. highlights: 99 agent-callable Xquik endpoints generated from OpenAPI
Separated read and action tools for least-privilege security
Includes bundled Hermes skill for agent usage guidance

Context4GPTs/klodi-plugin.summary: klodi-plugin is an agent-to-agent marketplace integration that enables AI agents to autonomously buy, sell, and negotiate on behalf of users. It functions through a system of host-specific adapters and a shared skill playbook that allows agents to list items, manage offers, and conduct private negotiations within user-defined policy constraints. The platform ensures privacy by keeping floor prices and negotiation strategies on the user's local disk while facilitating cross-platform identity and ratings. It supports multiple agent hosts including Hermes, OpenClaw, and Moltis, allowing users to switch environments without losing their marketplace history.
highlights: Automates listing, haggling, and closing deals via agent-to-agent communication
Maintains private negotiation strategies and floor prices on local storage
Provides cross-platform adapters for Hermes, OpenClaw, and Rust-based hosts

yepyhun/Brainstack.summary: Brainstack is a local-first memory kernel designed to replace flat memory blobs in Hermes agents with a structured, multi-layered memory model. It integrates three distinct memory lines—Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace—to handle session continuity, temporal graph relations, and large-corpus retrieval through a single memory owner. The system includes a dedicated installer and diagnostic tools to maintain stateful conversation continuity within the Hermes-Agent runtime.
highlights: Consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval
Uses SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for multi-layered data storage
Provides bounded evidence packing to reduce prompt noise

kfa-ai/hermes-timetree-sync.summary: hermes-timetree-sync is a Python-based CLI and library that enables Hermes Agents to manage TimeTree calendar events without manual user intervention. highlights: Syncs all-day and timed events using TimeTree web endpoints
Supports non-interactive batch writes for multiple calendar entries
Maps natural language terms to calendar labels via YAML policy

jau123/MeiGen-AI-Design-MCP.summary: MeiGen AI Design MCP is an open-source MCP server that enables AI coding tools to perform professional image and video generation. highlights: Supports 11 models including Midjourney, Flux, and local ComfyUI
Includes 1,446 curated prompt templates and style enhancement
Features parallel sub-agent orchestration for batch generation

highlights: Reduces prompt token overhead via local BM25 tool ranking
Includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings
Compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and native tool search

Executes on-chain actions via VaultPermissionManagerV2 with local policy gating
Anchors local session memory to IPFS and KnowledgeRegistryV2

volcengine/OpenViking.summary: OpenViking is an open-source context database designed to manage the fragmented memories, resources, and skills required by AI agents. Tiered L0/L1/L2 context loading to minimize token usage
Native directory recursive retrieval combined with semantic search

supermemoryai/supermemory.summary: Supermemory is a memory and context engine that provides AI agents with persistent memory across conversations. Hybrid search combining RAG and personalized memory
Connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub

Sub-100ms retrieval using a five-tier memory architecture
Built-in tools for code execution, file operations, and MCP integration

yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin.summary: The yantrikdb-hermes-plugin is a self-maintaining memory provider for Hermes Agent that replaces standard vector similarity with a temporal context graph. Maintains memory hygiene through automated consolidation and stale scans
Supports agent-authored skills with a native outcome ledger

Importance-weighted recall surfaces high-priority memories during context prefetch
Supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships between entries

Provides synchronous, on-demand summarization using Anthropic Claude models

Signet-AI/signetai.summary: Signet AI is a local-first context layer that provides agents with durable identity, memory, and secrets management. highlights: Local-first custody using SQLite and readable workspace files
Repairable memory with tools to edit, delete, or reclassify context
Portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and MCP clients

linke-ai/hermes-agent-team.summary: Hermes Agents Team is a local web-based system designed to orchestrate multi-agent collaboration using Hermes Agent profiles. highlights: Orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management
Integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local tool and communication handling
Real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban task flows

Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop.summary: Hermes Agent CN Desktop provides a dedicated desktop interface for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, simplifying local agent management and interaction. Integrated management for local and cloud model providers
Advanced UI for memory, skills, and task monitoring

Uses headless browsers for real-time parsing of any webpage
Supports Serper, Tavily, and SearXNG as search providers

Agent-3-7/minions.summary: Minions is a centralized management interface for Hermes Agent that replaces fragmented terminal sessions with a unified dashboard. highlights: Kanban board for tracking autonomous task status and review queues
Live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution
Human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions

CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room.summary: Hermes Agent Control Room is a governance template designed to prevent the fragmentation of disconnected bots by providing a centralized management plane. highlights: Tiered architecture for scaling from single agents to automated teams
Task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist task delegation
Bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management

colbymchenry/codegraph.summary: CodeGraph is a local semantic code intelligence tool designed to provide coding agents with precise context while reducing token consumption. highlights: Builds local semantic knowledge graphs for cross-file code intelligence
Reduces LLM token usage through surgical context retrieval
Auto-syncs indexes in real-time as developers modify project files

Task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation and handoffs

Includes 36 skills for deployment, monitoring, and GitHub integration
Automates the full lifecycle from product brief to production rollback

Compare adjacent requests using structured diffs
Supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Cursor, and more

Rich Markdown rendering with collapsible tool calls and inline images
Live quota tracking and burn-rate analytics for active agent sessions

Eliminates WSL2 requirement for running Hermes Agent
Integrated Web UI for chat, logs, and token usage analytics

ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart.summary: This unofficial community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Nous Research's Hermes Agent on Kubernetes clusters. It provides a structured configuration model that enforces state-safety guardrails, such as single-replica constraints and specific update strategies, to prevent data corruption in persistent environments. The chart supports both direct workload management and an operator-ready mode for platform teams using custom resource definitions. It is optimized for multi-tenant isolation, offering granular control over networking, storage, and secret management for individual agent instances.
highlights: Enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage
Supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows
Configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners

ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills.summary: YouTube Skills is a collection of tools that enables AI agents to interact with YouTube content without relying on browser automation or local binaries. It utilizes the TranscriptAPI backend to bypass cloud IP blocks, providing agents with direct access to video transcripts, search results, and channel metadata. The project integrates with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Claude Code using the Agent Skills format. Users can perform tasks like summarizing videos, extracting playlist contents, and searching for specific channel uploads through natural language prompts.
highlights: Extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp
Supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction
Compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Claude Code

stainlu/hermes-labyrinth.summary: Hermes Labyrinth is a read-only observability plugin for Hermes Agent that visualizes autonomous workflows as a structured map of events. It functions as a black-box recorder, reading local state to track prompts, tool calls, model transitions, and subagent activities without mutating session data. The tool provides deep diagnostic visibility through specialized views for skill overrides, scheduled cron tasks, and redacted journey reports. Users can export evidence in Markdown or JSON formats while relying on built-in redaction to protect sensitive credentials.
highlights: Visualizes agent journeys through ordered crossings and event maps
Provides diagnostic views for skill overrides and cron schedules
Generates redacted Markdown and JSON reports for session evidence

marshallrichards/ClawPhone.summary: ClawPhone provides scripts and configuration guides for deploying agent CLIs on Android devices. It leverages Termux to run these agents natively, utilizing proot or compatibility layers only when necessary. The project includes a streamlined installer for Google's Antigravity CLI and detailed implementation notes for running OpenClaw. This setup allows agents to operate in the background with potential access to phone hardware via Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
highlights: Automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android
Configuration guides for running OpenClaw in Termux
Hardware and UI access via Termux:API and Termux:GUI

agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires.summary: Agent of Empires is a session manager for AI coding agents on Linux and macOS that simplifies the coordination of multiple parallel agents. It leverages tmux to ensure sessions persist independently of the terminal, allowing users to monitor agent status via a TUI or a web-based dashboard. The system supports isolated environments through Docker sandboxing and git worktrees for managing different branches. It integrates with various agents including Hermes, Claude Code, and Gemini, providing tools for diff reviews and remote access via mobile devices.
highlights: TUI and PWA web dashboards for multi-agent monitoring
Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers for agent sandboxing
Parallel execution across git worktrees and multi-repo workspaces

nexu-io/open-design.summary: Open Design is a local-first, open-source design and prototyping system that serves as an alternative to Claude Design. It functions as a filesystem-based engine where coding agents read and write to a DESIGN.md design system to generate real CSS, fonts, and components. The platform supports the creation of web prototypes, motion graphics via HyperFrames, and presentation decks, all runnable within a sandboxed iframe. It integrates directly with various coding agents, including Hermes, to automate design workflows through a CLI-driven studio.
highlights: Generates web prototypes, HyperFrame motion graphics, and presentation decks.
Native CLI support for Hermes Agent and 22 local CLIs.
Exports artifacts to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats.

farion1231/cc-switch.summary: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop application designed to simplify the management and deployment of multiple AI agent interfaces and command-line tools. Built with the Tauri framework, it provides a unified graphical environment for configuring and switching between various agentic workflows. The tool supports a broad range of integrations including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It streamlines the setup process for developers using these tools on Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.
highlights: Unified manager for Hermes Agent and multiple CLI tools
Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux
Built with Tauri 2 for lightweight desktop performance

iOfficeAI/AionUi.summary: AionUi is an open-source desktop workspace that provides a unified graphical interface for interacting with local AI agents. It integrates a built-in agent engine with support for external CLI-based agents like Hermes Agent and Claude Code, allowing them to perform file operations and web searches under user supervision. The platform includes specialized assistants for generating editable Office documents, such as Morph PPTs, Word files, and Excel spreadsheets. Users can also configure scheduled automations via Cron and access the interface remotely through web or messaging platforms.
highlights: Unified GUI for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and 13+ CLI agents
Built-in engine for file access, web search, and MCP tools
Automated generation of editable PPT, Word, and Excel documents

futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin.summary: This plugin integrates the Exabase M-1 memory engine into Hermes Agent to provide persistent, long-term context for AI interactions. It functions by storing conversation turns and inferred memories in a self-organizing knowledge graph that resolves contradictions and evolves over time. Users can configure retrieval precision, enable query expansion, and utilize result reranking to fine-tune how the agent accesses stored facts and preferences. The integration includes dedicated tools for manual memory storage and searching, while also automatically processing conversation history in the background.
highlights: Integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory.
Provides tools for searching and manually storing specific memories.
Supports configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.

willingning-coder/eagle-eye.summary: Eagle Eye is a plugin for Hermes Agent designed to optimize skill selection by filtering large skill libraries into a small set of relevant candidates. It utilizes a five-layer retrieval architecture that combines deterministic keyword triggers, FTS5 text similarity, synonym matching, and dense semantic embeddings via RRF fusion. This approach reduces token consumption and prevents LLM confusion by providing only the most relevant skill hints rather than<pad> the entire list.
highlights: Five-layer retrieval including hard triggers and semantic embeddings
Reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls
Graceful degradation if embedding models or dependencies are missing

liftaris/herm.summary: Herm is an operator-focused terminal user interface (TUI) that centralizes the management of Hermes Agent into a single dashboard. Built with OpenTUI and Bun, it acts as a client for the Hermes Agent gateway rather than a standalone runtime. It allows users to chat with the agent, manage operational surfaces like cron jobs and memory, and track agentic work via an integrated kanban board. The tool also includes a system for discovering and installing Eikons, which are terminal avatars.
highlights: Integrated chat with markdown, LaTeX, and tool call rendering
Kanban boards for dispatching and diagnosing agentic work
TUI management of profiles, skills, toolsets, and memory

basilisk-labs/agentplane-hermes-plugin.summary: This plugin integrates AgentPlane into the Hermes ecosystem by enabling external Kanban worker lanes. It functions by intercepting Kanban assignees matching specific patterns and resolving them to an external supervisor command rather than a standard Hermes profile. The integration maintains strict boundaries by requiring AgentPlane to manage task lifecycles through official APIs instead of direct database mutations. It supports path allowlisting for secure workspace management and includes a diagnostic tool for verifying registry and binary configurations.
highlights: Maps agentplane-* Kanban assignees to external supervisor commands
Requires explicit task ID mapping via card metadata
Enforces security through AGENTPLANE_HERMES_ALLOWED_ROOTS path allowlisting

8bit64k/cronalytics.summary: Cronalytics is a plugin for Hermes Agent that provides observability and cost attribution for scheduled cron jobs. It utilizes the on_session_end hook to capture usage data and store it in a local SQLite fact database. Users can monitor job health and expenses through a visual dashboard, a programmatic CLI, and a specialized agent skill for automated diagnostics. This allows developers to identify failure patterns and optimize the economics of their agentic automations.
highlights: Tracks session-level usage and estimated costs for cron-originated runs
Provides visual insights via a dedicated Hermes dashboard tab
Includes a diagnostic agent skill for anomaly detection and recommendations

Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt.summary: This Hermes Agent plugin optimizes user prompts by rewriting them for clarity and efficiency before they reach the LLM. It intercepts messages across CLI, TUI, and gateway platforms, tailoring the rewrite based on the target model's vendor family and reasoning capabilities. The system supports multi-language detection to preserve original languages and records all interactions in a local SQLite database for longitudinal analysis. Users can monitor performance through dedicated slash commands for analytics and prompt-replacement patterns.
highlights: Tailors rewrites based on model family and reasoning capability
Preserves non-English prompts via langid or Unicode-range heuristics
Tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database

Sahil-SS9/MrHermagi-tutorbot.summary: MrHermagi-tutorbot is a Discord-based AI educational assistant that automates the delivery of structured learning paths using Hermes Agent profiles. The bot utilizes YAML-defined curricula to generate daily lessons consisting of Discord summaries, dark-mode HTML deep-dives, and TTS audio for mobile listening. It features a Socratic teacher persona that delivers content to forum channels and provides interactive Q&A support in dedicated text channels. Users can swap subjects by updating a configuration file without modifying the underlying infrastructure or restarting the gateway.
highlights: Delivers daily lessons via Discord forum threads with TTS audio
Uses YAML files to define and easily swap custom curricula
Provides interactive Q&A using a patient, analogy-driven Socratic persona

Sahil-SS9/hermes-Custom-CLI-Themes.summary: Hermes Custom CLI Themes is a collection of visual skins designed to personalize the Hermes Agent terminal interface. Each theme is defined in a single YAML file that configures color palettes, spinners, branding, and ASCII banner art. Users can apply these skins by placing them in a specific local directory and updating their configuration or using an in-app command. The project includes a variety of themed presets ranging from tactical and sci-fi aesthetics to minimalist investigator styles.
highlights: Provides YAML-based skins for terminal palettes and ASCII branding.
Includes a one-liner script for automated skin installation.
Supports custom extended keys for advanced UI element styling.

mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill.summary: mag3nt-pay is an agent payment skill that enables AI agents to autonomously pay for APIs that return HTTP 402 Payment Required errors. It works by detecting payment protocols from response headers, decoding the payment challenge, and settling the transaction using USDC via Mag3nt virtual cards. The skill supports Base, Solana, and most EVM networks, allowing agents to handle micropayments and subscriptions without human intervention. highlights: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC
Supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols
Compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and agentskills.io standard

indranilbanerjee/digital-marketing-pro.summary: Digital Marketing Pro is an open-source plugin designed to automate comprehensive marketing strategy and execution for agencies and in-house teams. EU AI Act Article 50 compliance ready

indranilbanerjee/socialforge.summary: SocialForge is an automation engine designed to manage monthly social media content calendars for agencies and in-house teams. It utilizes an asset-first compositing approach to<pad><pad>integrate brand photos into AI-generated scenes while maintaining pixel-level fidelity. The tool automates copy adaptation across multiple platforms and includes C2PA signing for EU AI Act compliance. highlights: Automates multi-platform content calendars and asset generation
Maintains brand integrity through asset-first compositing modes
Includes C2PA signing for content provenance and compliance

Sahil-SS9/hermaguard.summary: HermaGuard is an adversarial code review skill for AI agents designed to identify vulnerabilities and logic bugs without modifying source code. It utilizes a deterministic pre-scan layer featuring tools like Semgrep and Bandit followed by three parallel subagents that analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration blast radius. Findings are merged by a consolidator into structured Markdown and JSON reports for triage. The system includes a feedback MCP server to track fix rates and a benchmark suite to measure detection precision and recall.
highlights: Parallel subagents analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks.
Deterministic pre-scan layer integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec.
Feedback MCP server generates suppression rules to reduce false positives.

Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm.summary: Simplify Swarm is a multi-agent code refinement skill for Hermes Agent designed to automate deep code cleaning and technical debt reduction. It utilizes three specialized sub-agents—Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness—to analyze codebases for dead code, structural bloat, and complex bugs like N+1 queries or memory leaks. Findings are triaged into a risk-tiered system that separates safe automated fixes from risky architectural changes requiring human review. The tool supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and Go, serving as a comprehensive pre-PR inspection layer for developers.
highlights: Three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness
Risk-tiered triage system for safe, careful, and risky code modifications
Language-specific detection for N+1 queries and concurrency anti-patterns

Sahil-SS9/hermes-memlock.summary: MemLock is a context management plugin for Hermes that prevents standing instructions from being ignored after context compaction. It monitors the conversation for compaction markers and audits the active context to ensure pinned instructions, or anchors, have not drifted into the summary region. When an instruction is no longer detected in the model's working memory, the plugin rehydrates it as a reminder block in the current turn. This approach maintains model obedience over long dialogues without the token overhead of constant reinjection.

Rehydrates missing instructions using keyword probes or semantic embedding similarity
Provides a guard_pin tool for setting instruction priority and persistence

It provides an npm CLI and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that interfaces with a hosted workspace via API key authentication. The system supports campaign validation, asset uploads, and analytics tracking for platforms including X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok. highlights: Multi-platform posting to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and more
MCP server providing 17 validation-first publishing tools
CLI for schedule validation, asset management, and analytics

hlothaire/hermes-trace.summary: Hermes Trace is a plugin that provides visibility into agent execution by building structured trace graphs of session activity. It utilizes 18 lifecycle hooks to automatically capture LLM calls, tool usage, subagent spawns, and approval requests. Exports traces as JSON, Mermaid diagrams, and text trees
Includes ASCII Gantt timelines for analyzing span concurrency

nujovich/hermes-telemetry.summary: hermes-telemetry is an observability and budget enforcement plugin for Hermes Agent that prevents runaway costs during autonomous runs. It integrates directly into the runtime to track tokens and costs in real time, allowing it to block LLM calls before they exceed defined spending limits. Real-time token and cost tracking via runtime hooks
Visual cost analysis through a local HTML dashboard

MnrGreg/hermes-venice-web.summary: This plugin serves as a privacy-focused replacement for the built-in web search and extraction tools in Hermes Agent. Compatible with any LLM provider via standalone endpoints
Low-cost pricing at $0.01 per request

It connects the agent to a user-owned XMemo account to store and retrieve facts, preferences, and working states via semantic search and background prefetching. This allows Hermes to access context saved from other agents, including memories authorized through a ChatGPT bridge. The plugin integrates directly into the Hermes memory lifecycle, supporting native memory mirroring and session snapshots.
highlights: Cross-agent recall with semantic search and provenance tracking
Automatic memory mirroring from Hermes native memory tools
Durable state storage with session snapshots and TTL support

DIALLOUBE-RESEARCH/hypernatt-terminal.summary: HyperNatt Terminal is an MCP server that provides BTC/USDC decision context for AI agents based on a live Hyperliquid vault. It exposes nine read-only tools that deliver signals such as market maker trap states, hunt scores, and regime similarity. The system utilizes a pay-per-call x402 pricing model and integrates Li.Fi for cross-chain swap quotes. Li.Fi integration for cross-chain swap quotes

abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension.summary: The Hermes Browser Extension is a Chromium-based side panel that integrates the active web context with a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime. Captures page text, metadata, and URLs for context-aware prompting

tinyhumansai/tiny.place.summary: tiny.place provides a<pad>infrastructure layer for autonomous AI agents to establish identities, communicate, and conduct commerce. Automated health monitoring with multi-level recovery and circuit breakers
Token intelligence tracking drift, cost estimation, and memory bloat

DanielLi202/hermes-tag.summary: Hermes Tag is a context-selection layer for Hermes that prevents the agent from processing entire chat histories or only the last message. It uses a ContextSelector to reconstruct bounded evidence—including original images, notes, and relevant replies—only when the agent is @-mentioned. Implements isolated per-chat memory to prevent cross-channel data leaks.
Supports Feishu/Lark, Slack, and DingTalk integrations.

bergside/typeui.summary: TypeUI is an AI-first design platform that provides structured resources to help AI models generate more accurate and consistent user interfaces. Supplies curated UI prompts and design skills to AI models

Automatic ffmpeg fallback to MP3 audio attachments

The system automatically injects recent history during empty mentions or provides specific time-range summaries via a dedicated tool. Automatic context injection for empty mentions and relevant queries
Customizable retention periods and context window sizes per group

aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp.summary: Remote OpenClaw MCP Server provides a command-line and agent-native interface for searching a directory of over 13,000 MCP servers and 4,000 agent skills. chainbase-labs/Agentkey.summary: AgentKey is a unified integration layer that provides AI agents with access to real-time web, social media, and on-chain data. Automated configuration for over 40 AI agents and CLI tools
Bypasses login requirements and blocks on major social platforms
